title: Understanding N-grams
text: Think about how N-grams work. They capture sequences of letters, but do they consider the biological significance of codons?

title: Non-consecutive Segments
text: Consider how N-grams might treat sequences that aren't directly next to each other. How does this affect the representation of DNA sequences?

title: Meaningless Segments
text: Remember that in DNA, only sequences of three letters (codons) have biological meaning. How might N-grams capture sequences that don't have this structure?

title: Overlapping Segments
text: How does N-gram encoding handle overlapping sequences? Consider the sequence ATGCA. What overlapping segments would be captured?

title: Wrap-around Segments
text: Does N-gram encoding consider the end of a sequence as connected to the beginning? Think about how this might affect the representation of DNA sequences.
